plugins.name: spanner-security
plugins.description: Spanner PD's secure-by-default engineering standard, enforced as a pre-tool hook: a secret gate that scans every Bash command before it runs. THE HOOK IS THE WHOLE REASON THIS IS A PLUGIN — a hook is the one thing an org skill cannot express. The standard's text lives in the claude.ai Skills library as `spanner-security-standard`, set to Required; it is deliberately not duplicated here.
